English.Char_Desc_2000:
PDF Editor Pro is a fast, lightweight PDF editing application built specifically for Windows. It requires no internet connection for core features and does not upload your documents to any cloud service — everything runs locally on your machine.
Key Features: - Merge: Combine multiple PDF files into one with drag-and-drop page ordering - Split: Extract specific pages or page ranges from any PDF - Rotate: Rotate individual pages or entire documents (90°, 180°, 270°) - Compress: Reduce PDF file size with adjustable quality settings - Encrypt / Decrypt: Add or remove password protection (user and owner passwords) - Page management: Insert blank pages, delete pages, reorder via thumbnail view - Metadata editing: Edit document title, author, subject, and keywords - Multilingual: Full interface in English, Turkish, German, French, Spanish, Italian, Arabic, Russian
Technical details: - Built with Python + PyMuPDF for high-quality PDF processing - Native Windows window via WebView2 (no Electron) - Installer size: ~82 MB (includes all dependencies, no separate Python install needed) - Supports Windows 10 and Windows 11 (64-bit)
Licensing: - Demo: Free, up to 3 pages, watermark on save - Individual: $19 one-time, 1 PC - Corporate: $80 one-time, up to 5 PCs - License delivered by email instantly after purchase (Gumroad)
Website: https://mkbsoft.net
